== Strategy ==

Alright, this is how you use this deck...  First off, use the Death Star as your starting location, also use Twi'lek Advisor as a starting interrupt and deploy either Secret Plans or Imperial Decree(which ever you want to, but preferably Secret Plans).  The rest unfolds as you begin to draw cards.  Get out as many systems as possible and assign three Asteroid Fields and a Big One to one of them(try and put the other three asteroid fields and Big One on another system for double effect).  Try and take control of the systems as soon as you can and get a star destroyer(preferably Avenger because of its Asteroid Rules modifiers) to the Big One and start forcedraining on your next turn.  In addition, you may also want to add the Deflector Shield Generators to the star destroyer you chose to reduce its chances of getting hit by asteroids.

The other strong Capitals such as Devastator and Executor etc... along with the heavy TIE support(in compliance with All Power To Weapons) should provide the proper support to insure that noone trys to mess with you.  Effects such as Sienar Fleet Systems and Return to Base should help in your conquest(especially Return to Base's re-deployment abilities).  Please let me know if my explaination is to vague... Thanks and enjoy
